profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Fidelity Investments - Digital Assets
profile.summary:
Software Engineer | Problem Solver | Mission-Driven

I’m a results-driven software engineer with a passion for building scalable, high-quality solutions. With experience in full stack development, API design, and cloud technologies, I thrive in environments where I can tackle complex problems and drive innovation.

Currently, I work at Fidelity Investments Digital Assets, developing secure and efficient external facing applications. My expertise includes C#, Java, Python, Spring Boot, Angular, React.js, SQL, MongoDB, and AWS cloud services. I enjoy collaborating across teams to build impactful solutions that are both scalable and user-friendly.

Beyond my engineering career, I’m passionate about the intersection of technology and personal finance, with a strong interest in building systems that create long-term wealth and efficiency. Additionally, I’m deeply committed to mission work, both abroad and locally, supporting vulnerable communities by serving on the core team of a Non-profit organization as a lead and website developer.

Whether it’s solving complex tech challenges, scaling a business, or giving back to those in need, I believe in continuous learning and forward progress. Let’s connect and build something great!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led efforts and research in migrating DB from PostgreSQL to Aurora DSQL. Created complete migration guide for all teams to utilize
- Led initial design on how to implement performance tests for service using JMeter DSL
- Develop and maintain backend APIs in Java, acting as a secure intermediary between client applications and internal services.
- Implemented signature logic/verification mechanisms and payload signing to ensure secure client-server communication.
- Designed and applied robust validation logic, custom filters, and AOP-based aspects to enforce header and API-level security policies.
- Built a standalone automated submodule service using JUnit Platform Launcher to enable parallel automated test execution outside the main build pipeline.
- Led the initial design and development of an SDK module to expose internal API endpoints to external clients, enhancing integration capabilities.
- Designed and implemented standardized error handling across services using @ControllerAdvice and custom error handling filters for downstream service integration.
- Defined and delivered the initial design of a unified error response format, improving consistency and debuggability for client integrations.
- Utilize AWS, Docker, Jenkins, and GitHub for cloud infrastructure, containerization, CI/CD automation, and source control management.
- Conduct code reviews, contribute to system architecture discussions, and support continuous improvements across the backend engineering team.

positions.title: Agile Development Professional
positions.description:
- Designed the MongoDB database structure for a new mini front-end service, enhancing efficiency.
- Developed a system to save filter selections using Angular and Java, improving user experience.
- Collaborated with other teams to help them get up to speed on project logic and workflows.
- Created and managed multiple AMQ topics to facilitate smooth messaging across services.

positions.title: Agile Development Associate II
positions.description:
- Utilized Angular for front-end development and Spring Java for backend, contributing to the creation and implementation of microservices architecture.
- Engineered multiple bulk APIs, significantly enhancing user experience by streamlining processes and boosting operational speed
- Played a pivotal role in onboarding new team members by providing mentorship, specifically guiding college hires in understanding the architectural framework and advocating Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
- Stepped in as a delegate for the manager during their absence, effectively managing team responsibilities and ensuring smooth operations.
- Implemented robust integration and unit tests using Cypress and Cucumber to guarantee service reliability and scalability.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Used Java (edge service) to connect the python standalone service to the database and UI using Spring
- Built applications using CI/CD, DevOps Tools (Jira, Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube, Fortify)
- Initiated multiple improvements in the creation and maintenance of a large-scale SQL database used by multiple scrum teams
- Architected and led development for the enhancement of a legacy tool previously written in MATLAB and optimizing the algorithms in Python using Object-Oriented Programming.
- Helped design high-level architecture for API services
- Developed UI/UX design by using React.js and Plotly.
- Created a script to automate database creation, modification, and population of tables which decreased time that it took to complete database tickets from days to hours.
- Led the company to meet a critical deadline through optimization of algorithms and reduced the build time from over 48 hours to less than a minute.

positions.title: Software Engineer Asc
positions.description:
- Used Python, Java, and Git to design and implement microservices architecture for CRT teams that we supported.
- Collaborated on a high-priority scrum team to implement the auto-generation of Hibernate
Object/Release Mapping to interact with a SQL database.
- Created tools that would generate autogenerate code (json to java, json to python, and json to jpa) 
- Implemented Test Driven Development to create unit tests to validate that each unit of the software code performed as expected.

positions.title: Lab Assistant/Technician
positions.description:
- Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve a range of software, hardware and connectivity issues. 
- Maintain the daily performance of the computer systems.
- Remote access computers and monitor the usage of computers and Install software on desktops.
- Handled troubleshooting and maintenance of IT equipment. Provided support in monitoring and deployment of IT equipment to students and faculty.

positions.title: 1890 Scholar/IT Specialist Intern
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
- Received a 4 year Full Ride Scholarship for University
- Supported Marketing & Regulatory Program Business Services to ensure computers for USDA personnel were properly imaged, wiped and configured with required authentication codes.
- Coordinated the acquisition and installation of equipment and the implementation of new and upgraded data networking services.
- Stored issuances and directives for departmental digital and physical records management.
- Coordinated a program in South Carolina and Delaware, dedicated to freshman and sophomore high school students teaching them about the role of Information technology in the government sector.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
- Observed functionality of traffic lights, cameras and other safety tools in the county. 
- Corrected issues as appropriate with inoperable stoplights and cameras. 
- Conducted inventory on computer systems, resolved minor bug fixes and created documentation to track existing traffic light incidents and assist with future development projects.

company.name: Department of Public Works and Transportation

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Tutored Children (Grades: Kindergarten - 5th)
- Helped students plan out their dreams by meeting with them one on one weekly and help them set goals
- Served as a mentor and connected students with people in their dream field

- Coordinate and lead weekly Sunday food and clothing outreach program supporting individuals experiencing homelessness. Responsibilities include: leading food distribution, welcoming and assigning tasks to volunteers, overseeing the flow of the program, assisting with setup and logistics, and ensuring a warm, organized environment for guests and volunteers.
- Created a new website for the organization and moved it to a secure platform. Responsibilities include: designing and updating website frequently
